title: Every vertex of the de Bruijn digraph has indegree and outdegree two
statement: Let $n \ge 2$ be an integer, and let $v$ be any vertex of the de Bruijn digraph $D_n$. Then both the indegree and the outdegree of $v$ equal $2$; that is, $d^{-}(v) = 2$ and $d^{+}(v) = 2$.
hypotheses_covered: v is an arbitrary vertex of D_n (an (n-1)-bit string)
replaced:
\emph{Clearly, \texttt{D\_n} is connected and each
vertex of \texttt{D\_n} has indegree two and outdegree two.}
